analysis: The only change in this PR is documentation in docs/developer/test.md. The head hunk adds a 'Cluster Pair Coordinated Update' test section after line 1042. It describes ClusterPairUpdateTests and ClusterServiceUpdateTests, which use loopback MockCoordinator, temporary installs, and scripted pair owners. The supplied patch excerpt is truncated and the base text units show only unchanged surrounding content, so the full added text and the underlying test or source code were not visible. This is documentation, not a change to executable code, key handling, attestation, encryption, authorization, or the cache. No threat-model assets, trust boundaries, or mitigations (e.g. T-041, T-043, T-053, TB-011) are affected by this text. Nothing in the visible lines weakens a control. The described behavior is test scaffolding only: staged updates, admission closure and rollback, with the real updater on temporary install roots. Open questions for integration: the PR's non-doc source changes (ClusterPairUpdateCycle, the cluster update coordination, the start check that runs a temporary install's darkbloom script) were not supplied here. If they are in the PR, they should be reviewed against T-043 (watchdog and rollback authority), the self-updater hash and signature checks, and the drain and admission semantics. No concrete regression is identifiable from this documentation alone.
